sample_unit: outputs per workflow (patient-friendly explanations of incidental MRI findings)

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch Reading Ease) and ICD-10 alignment of LLM patient-friendly explanations across four workflows
links.effect: Across 407 outputs per workflow, the agentic workflow achieved a sixth-grade reading level and the highest accuracy; results for the other workflows are not given in the abstract.
links.quote: Across 407 outputs per workflow, the agentic method demonstrated the strongest overall performance, achieving a sixth-grade reading level and the highest accuracy.

unlisted_practices: Using agentic, few-shot, or multiple few-shot prompting workflows to improve readability and accuracy of LLM-generated patient-friendly radiology explanations

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares different LLM deployment prompting/workflow strategies (zero-shot, few-shot, agentic) to ensure readability constraints and accuracy for patient-facing radiology explanations.

primary.practice: agentic workflow vs prompting strategies for readability and accuracy
